title: GridTalk UDP packet protocol v2
description: One UTF-8 JSON object per UDP datagram to 127.0.0.1:9999. Includes the legacy v1 reset emitted by the TS3 sender. See docs/SENDER_PROTOCOL.md for cross-packet constraints and lifecycle.

client_id.description: Stable positive member ID within this source and channel. Map larger provider IDs to local integers.

name.description: Display name; UTF-8, including Unicode and escaped JSON characters.

talking.description: True means transmitting. Null means unknown: retain previous state in the same channel or default to false.

self.description: The local voice-app user; adds (you) to the displayed name.

v.description: Wire protocol version; independent of the application version.

source.description: Stable sender stream identity, e.g. teamspeak or discord. Missing source maps to default for backward compatibility. New senders should always supply it.

snapshot.description: Strictly increasing complete-snapshot sequence per source. All pages of a snapshot use the same value.

page.description: Zero-based page index; must be less than pages (semantic constraint).

server.description: Opaque provider identifier. Encode numeric provider IDs as strings to preserve precision.

channel.description: Opaque provider identifier. Encode numeric provider IDs as strings to preserve precision.
